assertion10.statement: The fixed-determinant framed ring for eta direct-sum eta omega is formally smooth of relative dimension2 over its versal hull.
assertion10.objects: G_Q5; eta and mod5 cyclotomic omega; residual two-dimensional representation; O-coefficient hull Rver and framed ring Q.
assertion10.hypotheses: p-finiteness and existence of hull/framed ring as in the Pan setup; omega nontrivial; fixed determinant chi; strict conjugacy equivalence.
assertion10.quantifiers: Every actual object satisfying the stated case conditions; no selection of an unrelated representation.
assertion10.parameter_range: p=5, d=2, arbitrary finite coefficient E/Q5; actual split residual case.
assertion10.uniformity: No numerical bound over varying representations is needed; all field, lattice and deformation choices are fixed for each application.
assertion10.constants: No analytic constants. Numerical tangent/cohomology dimensions are specified in each statement.
assertion10.normalizations: All endomorphisms Ad have dimension4 and invariant dimension2; trace-zero ad0 has dimension3 and invariant dimension1; same B1 dimension2.
assertion10.exceptional_cases: Do not use this centralizer count when the residual characters coincide, including p2. Pan nonsplit Paškūnas case is separate.
assertion10.limit_order: Complete local rings and continuous cohomology carry their stated topologies.

assertion10.statement: For actual odd irreducible rho_E, dim H1(G_F,S,ad0rho_E)-dim H2(G_F,S,ad0rho_E)=2[F:Q].
assertion10.objects: Three-dimensional trace-zero adjoint of Pan rho_E, finite E/Q5, totally real F and finite S containing5 and infinity.
assertion10.hypotheses: Continuous odd irreducible rho_E, finite ramification, same S; odd involution has E-rational eigenvalues+1,-1.
assertion10.quantifiers: Every actual object satisfying the stated case conditions; no selection of an unrelated representation.
assertion10.parameter_range: p5; every F/E/rho in the stated actual setup.
assertion10.uniformity: No numerical bound over varying representations is needed; all field, lattice and deformation choices are fixed for each application.
assertion10.constants: No analytic constants. Numerical tangent/cohomology dimensions are specified in each statement.
assertion10.normalizations: Ordinary real-place H0 has dimension1; global trace-zero H0 vanishes; h0-h1+h2 equals real invariant sum minus3[F:Q].
assertion10.exceptional_cases: Irreducibility without the actual odd involution would need separate scalar-endomorphism justification; p2 not covered by the integral averaging proof.
assertion10.limit_order: Complete local rings and continuous cohomology carry their stated topologies. For the Euler substitute, fix F,S,E,V,L, take n to infinity, then divide by [E:Q5].

assertion10.statement: The natural fixed-determinant E-deformation ring map R_B to the completion of (R_b)_(p_B) is an isomorphism.
assertion10.objects: Nonzero B in Ext1(psi1,psi2); nonsplit rho_B with subcharacterpsi2 and quotientpsi1; chosen integral nonsplit residual lattice rho_b; exact characteristic-zero primep_B.
assertion10.hypotheses: Distinct characters in E and k; nonsplit extensions; universal representability; stable lattice as selected by Pan; finite E/Q5, O its ring of integers; fixed determinantchi.
assertion10.quantifiers: Every actual object satisfying the stated case conditions; no selection of an unrelated representation.
assertion10.parameter_range: p5, each actual B and lattice individually; no uniform denominator acrossB.
assertion10.uniformity: No numerical bound over varying representations is needed; all field, lattice and deformation choices are fixed for each application.
assertion10.constants: No analytic constants. Numerical tangent/cohomology dimensions are specified in each statement.
assertion10.normalizations: Artinian E-algebras use finite-dimensional E topology; O coefficients make point residue equalE; p inverted before completing gives the same completion; strict equivalence reduces to identity.
assertion10.exceptional_cases: General versal source gives only smoothness, not isomorphism. Split/scalar residual cases are not included. Lattice existence retained as a premise.
assertion10.limit_order: Complete local rings and continuous cohomology carry their stated topologies.
